### `CurrencyDatPatcher`

**Kind:** `class` · **Namespace:** `LocalExile.Client.AssetPipeline.Dat64` · **Source:** `LocalExile.Client.AssetPipeline/Dat64/CurrencyDatPatcher.cs`

Reusable PoE 3.29.3d custom currency `.datc64` & `.it` patcher. public enum PoeDdsFormat

| Value | Summary |
|---|---|
| `Rgba8 = 0` | DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM (28), PoE header enum 21 (0x15). Used by stock 2D item/pet icons and lossless alpha textures. |
| `Bc1 = 1` | DXGI_FORMAT_BC1_UNORM (71), PoE header enum 205 (0xCD). Used by stock opaque colour textures (DXT1). |
| `Bc3 = 2` | DXGI_FORMAT_BC3_UNORM (77), PoE header enum 207 (0xCF). Block-compressed RGBA (DXT5). |
